title: SC-02 owner-authorized asset continuation independent review, ordinal 5

reviewer.role: Independent reviewer context separate from builder
reviewer.method: Direct image-tool inspection of all six changed pipeline PNGs, prior blocked vase alternate and one supplied actual Studio vase view. Exact-byte comparison carries forward the 58 unchanged previously independently inspected images. Metadata and counters are corroboration, never visual-quality proof.
reviewer.identityLimitation: Reviewer identity and source fields record provenance; they do not cryptographically authenticate a person or browser session.

objective.qualityStandard: Recognizable detailed geometry, convincing proportions, appropriate real-time PBR response, coherent authored finish and distinct catalog objects; no primitive stand-ins called production complete.
objective.scope: Exported GLB pipeline renders; actual product continuation is captured separately.
objective.continuationObjective: Premium production-quality spatial creative assets; resolve the previously blocked porcelain finish at supplied views without lowering the full catalog standard.

sourceIdentity.actualStudioSourceAttribution: Supplied completed authenticated production-browser showcase at packet productSource; pixels independently inspected. Reviewer did not drive or authenticate the browser. Byte-identical immutable copy under pipeline is bound. Full runtime and journey receipt review remains separate.
unrelatedWorkingTreeStateObserved: tsconfig.json modified by concurrent browser build/capture; not inspected or changed by reviewer

authorization.provenanceBoundary: Provided authorization record attributes the continuation to directly read human messages; independent reviewer preserves that record and its hash, not a new owner-product acceptance.

evidence.packetDigestAlgorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 LF-joined repository-relative path, TAB, lowercase SHA256, sorted by path, no trailing LF

overall.dispositionScope: Asset rendered-quality finding only; not significant product/owner acceptance
overall.rationale: The formerly fragmented vase decoration is now coherent in the new exported thumbnail/alternate and one actual Studio capture. All 29 other GLBs are exact prior bytes, all 58 unchanged asset images retain prior independently inspected bytes, and the four additionally changed renders show no new confirmed regression. These observations resolve the specific vase finish finding without resetting historical review/correction counts or certifying the entire product.

findings.observation: Blue neck/foot bands and floral motifs read as deliberate continuous decoration on the smooth white glazed vessel. The prior sparse fragmented bands and jagged interrupted motifs are no longer visible at these supplied views. The actual selected Studio view confirms that the repaired appearance is present in the real renderer at one Gallery viewpoint.
findings.limitation: Resolution is bounded to supplied views; broader journey, all viewing angles, device/native, protected and owner acceptance are separate.

findings.observation: Only one actual Studio vase view was added to this asset packet. Its visible support, framing and finish are useful evidence; they do not establish complete Creator keyboard/recovery/motion/audio/save/reload or full spatial-pilot contract completion.
No shared consumer integration/acceptance proof is supplied in this exported-asset packet. The prior product review gate remains unchanged; resolving the vase pixels cannot discharge it.

dimensions.recognizability: Thirty requested asset categories retain recognizable authored forms. The new vase clearly reads as a decorative porcelain vessel.
dimensions.detailedGeometry: The new vase retains a curved hollow mouth, neck, rounded body and foot. Other 29 GLBs are unchanged; prior bounded geometry observations remain applicable. No model becomes a primitive stand-in through this repair.
dimensions.proportions: Vase and changed furniture/prop renders have plausible broad proportions; actual vase support table provides a useful scene context. Meter scale and general placement correctness remain unverified.
dimensions.materialResponse: The vase now shows coherent blue decoration on a soft glazed white surface. Changed sofa/trunk/painting/map renders preserve distinct fabric, case, metallic/wood frame and paper character. Arbitrary lighting and quality-tier robustness remain unproven.
dimensions.normals: No gross missing/inverted face observed in the changed renders; full normal/tangent validation is not established by these static views.
dimensions.consistency: Shared dark-background pipeline presentation and restrained stylized catalog language remain coherent. The actual Studio vase retains its identity in a contextual scene.
dimensions.distinctiveness: All 29 unchanged GLBs preserve previous distinct categories; the vase floral finish is a meaningful authored surface on its own distinct vessel, not a counted recolor variant.
dimensions.premiumStandard: The previously confirmed finish defect is repaired at supplied views without waiving it. Thirty bounded visual passes support asset-view quality only; the mandatory behavior, optimization, provenance, full actual-product and owner acceptance requirements still need their own evidence.

capabilityStatus.exportedPipeline: 64 artifact images, all bound by hashes; six changed images directly inspected, 58 carried by exact-byte identity to prior independent review. All 30 working-tree GLBs and manifest match exact committed candidate bytes.
capabilityStatus.assetRendering: 30 PASS_AT_SUPPLIED_VIEWS; zero confirmed new visible repair blockers in this packet.
capabilityStatus.actualStudioVase: One 1440x900 supplied actual Studio capture directly inspected and byte-preserved in pipeline; specific rendered finish supported in context.
capabilityStatus.performance: OBSERVATION_ONLY: supplied SwiftShader WebGL metrics are not normal-device editor performance, memory lifecycle or physical/native qualification.
capabilityStatus.provenance: Metadata declares AI-assisted original assets and a proprietary license; this visual review does not independently audit source ownership or redistribution rights.

limitations: Static isolated views and one actual Studio vase view cannot certify hidden surfaces, arbitrary lighting, 360-degree motion, all quality tiers or all target devices.
The single Studio screenshot was supplied from the builder capture; the independent reviewer inspected its pixels and bound its bytes but did not re-drive the authenticated browser.

Prior local product fixes and unsupported keyboard/focus/motion/audio/adverse/shared-consumer dimensions remain governed by the preserved prior product review until separately reviewed fresh evidence is supplied.

The Preview only restriction remains visible in the captured inspector. This report records rendered resolution and does not change implementation, catalog availability, runtime labels, historical evidence or release status.
The four prior asset reports and their BLOCK_WITH_EVIDENCE history are retained; this explicit owner-authorized ordinal-5 asset review is not a reset or concealment of prior bounded-loop outcomes.
